user_input: How does Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhance the performance of language models in generating responses?
reference: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) enhances the performance of language models by combining retrieval systems with language models. Instead of relying only on model memory, RAG fetches relevant documents from external knowledge sources. Retrieved content is added to the prompt before generating a response. This improves factual accuracy and reduces hallucinations.
reference_contexts:
Page 2 - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation combines retrieval systems with language models. Instead of relying
only on model memory, RAG fetches relevant documents from external knowledge sources. Retrieved
content is added to the prompt before generating a response. This improves factual accuracy and
reduces hallucinations.
